'''Factory''' is a [[Locations|location]] under the [[Inquisition Base]].

There are four ways to reach the Factory: from the [[Writing Basement]], from the [[Old Mine]], from beneath the [[Crossroads]], and from the [[Vineyard Basement]]. Each route requires clearing at least one Blockage, which requires {{item|Iron Detail|4}} and {{Item|Reinforced Beam|1}}.

Here, the [[Keeper]] can use [[zombies]] to automate the production of certain items. Some items can only be produced here. The Factory has storage areas for {{Item|Log}}, {{Item|Stone}}, {{Item|Sand}}, {{Item|Clay}}, {{Item|Coal}}, {{Item|Iron Ore}}, and {{Item|Marble}}, which are transported from their respective locations by zombies assigned to the [[Porter Station]].
